ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates C1, Cavern A, and Cavern B accountable roles to the implementation team and requires encountered fluids to be finitely contained rather than used as a planning stop. This exact C1 package requires a dry finite target halo and leaves both cavern thresholds closed; it does not authorize an outfall, water displacement, or cave opening.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact three-package C1 core liner and closed Cavern A/B vestibule transaction emitted by MP08-C1-SEALED-CONTAINMENT-CORRIDOR-01.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No C2, Cavern C, RR-N6, T4, cavern receiver excavation, public opening, emergency egress, transport, active control, water displacement, or fluid outfall is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Independent structural QA must bind complete canonical block states, exact target bijection, package disjointness, and forward/rollback inversion.
Every live invocation captures a fresh immutable complete source snapshot and passes exact forward source preflight in package order.
Every forward and rollback operation file must pass strict-noop parser validation before mutation.
The exact target and finite interaction halo must be clear of block entities and fresh same-moment live entities before execution.
Forward execution must be strict-noop and journaled. Any failure triggers the exact inverse for the partial and already-committed package set in reverse order.
A fresh immutable post snapshot, exact rollback poststate preflight, and release-specific sealed-corridor functional QA are mandatory before an as-built claim.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failed C1 containment check blocks only this transaction and cannot be used to reopen, mutate, or classify either cavern.
